I can't stand when men tell women period pain is just normal because I'd bet money they couldn't handle how harsh my periods are

I've lost count of how many times I've heard some version of “it's just your period”

Usually from a man who has absolutely no idea what he's talking about

They make it sound like you should take a painkiller, get some sleep and carry on with your day

But my periods weren't like that

Every month, I could practically feel my life coming to a halt

A few days before my period, my energy would start disappearing

I'd wake up tired after a full night's sleep

I'd sit down to answer an email and completely lose my train of thought

I'd have things I needed to get done and somehow couldn't find the energy to do any of them

Then the irritability would hit

The smallest things could set me off

I'd snap at people I cared about and then feel awful about it afterward

And once my period actually started, the heavy bleeding would leave me feeling completely wiped out

It wasn't just a bad day

It was several days of feeling like I had nothing left in the tank

I'd cancel plans

I'd put off work

I'd spend my evenings on the couch because even basic things felt exhausting

And the frustrating part was what happened afterward

My period would end, but I wouldn't suddenly bounce back

I'd spend the rest of the month trying to catch up from those few days

It felt like I was constantly recovering from the last cycle just in time for the next one to start

For the longest time, I thought I just had to accept it

That's what everyone kept telling me

It's normal

Every woman gets a period

Just push through it

But eventually I started asking myself a different question

If my period was leaving me feeling this depleted every month, was I paying enough attention to what my body was losing and what I was putting back?

That's when I started looking beyond the generic “take a painkiller and push through it” advice

I started learning more about nutrients like iron and B12 and how important they are for normal energy and red blood cell production

And that's what led me to Primal Queen's Beef Organs

It gives me a simple daily source of nutrient-dense beef organs with naturally occurring iron and B12, along with other nutrients like zinc and selenium

No complicated supplement routine

No handful of different bottles sitting on my counter

Just one simple way to add more nutrient-dense support to my daily routine

I can't say it magically made my periods disappear

But it completely changed how I think about that week of the month

I stopped looking at feeling depleted as something I was supposed to simply ignore

And I stopped assuming that “normal” meant I shouldn't pay attention to it

Because your period already takes enough out of you

Your nutrition should help put something back
